purpose: final development test of a task-agnostic state-aware horizontal controller combined with fixed vertical skills
analysis_scope: Development only. The two cases were selected after T1 and reused in T2; this run cannot support a held-out claim.
controller_rules: After three consecutive wait or wait1 actions, require an examine command before allowing another wait action.
For non-wait commands, intervene only when the same command repeats and neither score nor observation changes.
The controller cannot read task-family labels or inject a task-specific solution.

development_gate.success: successful episodes for t3_full must be greater than successful episodes for t3_vertical
development_gate.interaction: the preregistered success interaction must be greater than zero
development_gate.cost: average total tokens for t3_full must not exceed 1.25 times t3_vertical

failure_rule: If any development-gate condition fails, stop horizontal tuning on these cases and report that the tested T-shaped combination is not established.
next_step_if_passed: Freeze a new task suite before evaluating the unchanged T3 controller.
next_step_if_failed: Retain the vertical-Skill result and report the T-shaped combination as unsupported in the tested setting.
